items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: So when Louis was working at the Dreamland with Ollie Powers Band, that's after he'd left Oliver

ctx.x: Yeah, on the west side. But I didn't work with him any place else. So when Louis was working at the Dreamland with Ollie Powers Band, that's after he'd left Oliver, everybody started talking about Louis playing because it was the first time he'd been able to be heard alone, you see. So Freddie heard about people talking about Louis one night. No, Louis was working with me that time. It wasn't Ollie Powers. I had the band there for a short time. That's after he left Fletcher Hennessey. That's what I thought. You…
